What I’ve been reading in 2026 (finished and in-progress):

  • The Dead Hand - David Hoffman
  • Kalpa Imperial: The Greatest Empire That Never Was — Angélica Gorodischer (translated by Ursula K. Le Guin).
  • Good Strategy/Bad Strategy - Richard Rumelt
  • Mountains of the Mind - Robert Macfarlane
  • The Master and Margarita - Mikhail Bulgakov (translated by Diana Burgin & Katherine Tiernan O’Connor)
  • The Little Prince - Antoine de Saint-Exupéry (translated by Richard Howard)
  • Stoner - John Williams
  • Parable of the Sower - Octavia E. Butler
  • 1984 - George Orwell
  • Siddhartha - Hermann Hesse
  • Project Hail Mary - Andy Weir
